info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Document Validation Management API
info.description: The Document Validation Management API facilitates the validation process for banking documents within a specified directory. This endpoint allows users to submit document validation requests, ensuring compliance and integrity of financial records. Typical consumers include financial institutions and compliance officers who require assurance that submitted documents meet necessary standards. With this API, businesses can streamline their document processing workflows while maintaining regulatory adherence.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new validation for the specified document directory identified by the resource ID 'RES-100045'. It validates the documents to ensure they meet the required standards before further processing.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to validate the documents in the specified directory. It requires a JSON payload that conforms to the defined schema for validation operations, which includes all necessary attributes and their expected formats.
